opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an exceptional, independent researcher with a permanent or fixed‑term position, based at a UK university or UK not‑for‑profit research organisation and have teaching and admin duties; co‑applicants must also be UK‑based independent researchers with permanent or fixed‑term positions and belong to a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research across the social sciences, humanities, natural sciences and engineering, supporting collaborations between the British Academy, Royal Society and Royal Academy of Engineering.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK, any career stage, with prior public‑engagement experience; previous award‑holders cannot re‑apply.
opportunities.summary: Funding for public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts organisations to bring humanities and social sciences to wider audiences.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with UK or German research institutions in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’ with travel, accommodation and visa costs covered; seed funding for post‑symposium collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or recognised research organisation, with a doctorate completed between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027, and not holding a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to conduct independent research and develop teaching experience in the humanities or social sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑resident researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK higher‑education institution or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Skill‑development awards to support quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities and language‑learning capacities.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a UK‑based researcher in the humanities or social sciences, post‑doctoral level or above, with at least one overseas co‑applicant; interdisciplinary collaboration required.
opportunities.summary: 24‑month interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, led by UK humanities/social sciences researchers with international partners.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP Berlin to develop policy‑relevant analysis in security, Indo‑European relations, technology and strategy‑making.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible in exceptional cases)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs such as equipment, caring costs, or assistance with applying to British Academy calls.
